title: Inspect object sizes in the recording
description: You can compare getsizeof calls with their recorded values rather than treating comments as universal sizes.

steps.description: sys.getsizeof reports a size for the integer object 42. The supplied recording reports 28.
The next call measures True. Its recorded value is also 28.

steps.question: Does the supplied recording agree with the string-size comment of 51?
steps.answer: No. The recording reports 43 for this string.

steps.description: The three recorded sizes are 28, 28, and 43. Read them as observations from this runtime, with object bookkeeping described by the final comment.
